answers.anthropic_why_anthropic: Anthropic sits at the intersection of three things I care most about: frontier AI that is genuinely safe and steerable, enterprise adoption in regulated industries, and building trusted systems that deliver real business value. In my current role at Merck, I have built and scaled enterprise AI and GenAI products — including an in-house RAG/LLM platform — across regulated healthcare markets in Europe. I have seen firsthand how much enterprise customers need a partner who combines technical depth with safety, reliability, and a consultative approach. Anthropic's mission to make powerful AI safe and beneficial, combined with the DACH Applied AI Architect team's focus on helping large enterprises adopt Claude responsibly, is the exact environment where my experience in enterprise AI leadership, regulated-industry transformation, and team building can have the most impact.

answers.celonis_best_team_wins: To me, the best team wins means that no single person — no matter how talented — outperforms a group of people who genuinely trust each other, challenge each other's thinking, and stay aligned on what matters. In my experience leading cross-functional AI and data teams across pharma and insurance, the breakthroughs never came from one brilliant individual. They came when we got the right mix of perspectives in the room — engineers who understood the business, consultants who could code, domain experts willing to question the model. I try to build teams where people feel safe enough to disagree, skilled enough to deliver, and connected enough to the mission that they push through the hard parts together.
